title: SOS: burst allowance of 2 in rate limiter
description: Gap 2 of a6qg: spec 18.4.1 'Burst allowance: 2' unimplemented. SosResource.check_rate_limit (python/src/lichen/coap/resources/emergency.py) applies the 600s cooldown to every repeat, so a second SOS at +1s is rejected where spec permits. Implement burst semantics per vector cooldown_resets_on_accept (accepts at t=0 and t=1000ms; accept at t=600000; reject at t=601000). Flip xfail(strict) test_burst_second_accepted_exact_pin; update green doc test test_burst_second_rejected_live_behavior.
notes: SRC SIDE DONE (worker2, branch beads-worker-2): burst allowance 2 implemented as cooldown-period semantics mirroring main's landed evaluate_rate_limit: per-source _period_start anchor; hourly cap (>=3/hr) checked first; at/after period_start+600s a new period opens (cooldown_elapsed); within an open period allow while period_count < SOS_BURST_MAX(2) (within_burst); else deny with retry_after=ceil(period_start+600-now) clamped max(1,..) (cooldown_active). Verifies vector cooldown_resets_on_accept: accept t=0, t=1s (burst), t=600s (period rollover), reject t=601s (hourly cap from accumulated history). Stage 2: remove xfail on test_burst_second_accepted_exact_pin (XPASSes now); rewrite green doc tests test_burst_second_rejected_live_behavior, test_request_within_cooldown_blocked, test_different_sources_independent (immediate-repeat is now burst-allowed), test_cooldown_resets_on_accept (expected codes now [2.01,2.01,2.01,4.29]).
